task_description: Implement CAMPASS Phase 0 Identity & RBAC (decision B2), identity-rbac.md §3–§8, on main with no worktree. Add the membership/role/permission model + a hand-authored RLS migration + seed, a shared permission catalogue, the dual-shape JWT + authenticate pipeline, a central authz engine, and migrate GatePass/campus_movement routes to requirePermission behind a compatibility shim so the app keeps working at every step. User.role and User.institutionId are kept for the shim; the B-1 tenancy migration is never altered; campass_app never gets BYPASSRLS.
